verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents API keys only as personal access tokens that call the same endpoints the web UI uses, so a key carries its owner's full privileges. Nothing in the evidence shows per-key scopes or restricted permissions for agent credentials. The RBAC system governs users and roles rather than individual API keys, so least-privilege would depend on a workaround such as creating a dedicated restricted user, which does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
